title: [UE-0.5b] Owl data types and Owl tests
body:

### Inputs and outputs (exact paths)

Inputs: the files the Done-when names. Outputs: `Source/UmbrellaElla/Public/Owl/**`, `Source/UmbrellaElla/Private/Owl/**`, `Source/UmbrellaElla/Private/Tests/Owl/**`, `pipeline/qa/test-map.md`

### Context (what the code or asset next to Outputs does today, with file:line)

new files only

### File lane, do-not-touch paths, binary files to lock

Lane: `Source/UmbrellaElla/Public/Owl/**`, `Source/UmbrellaElla/Private/Owl/**`, `Source/UmbrellaElla/Private/Tests/Owl/**`, `pipeline/qa/test-map.md`
Do not touch: Content/UmbrellaElla/Maps/**
Locks: none

### Out of scope (behaviors not to build; the reviewer rejects them)

anything outside the lane

### After (cards that must merge first: #<n> or UE-<n>, comma separated; "none")

UE-0.5

### Used by (BPs, maps, widgets or components that read what this card changes; follow-up card IDs)

UE-0.8a

### Needs (build | tests | editor MCP | Windows packaging machine)

build, tests, Windows packaging machine

### Done when (each line checkable)

- [ ] `UOwlPatternData` and `UOwlPhaseData` primary data assets exist with the fields listed in `pipeline/level/encounter.md`
- [ ] `tools/ue/test.sh --require UmbrellaElla.Owl.EveryPatternHasTelegraph --require UmbrellaElla.Owl.PhaseTableDistinct` prints PASS (pasted). Each test builds its own transient pattern and phase data, so it never passes on zero assets
- [ ] With a planted pattern whose telegraph is 0, `EveryPatternHasTelegraph` FAILS once (pasted), then the plant is removed
- [ ] The three owl world tests belong to the MVP 5 and MVP 8 cards (`pipeline/qa/test-map.md`)
- [ ] The Owl row in `pipeline/qa/test-map.md` is set to merged with this card's number

### Budget and cut tier

60 min agent + 15 min human, MVP

none
